definitions.explanation: Describes things that are separated, scattered, or not together.
Describes opinions, times, or qualities that differ from each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: The books fell off the bookshelf and scattered in the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まらない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: We can't decide because opinions vary so much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting times are all different, which is a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点数|てんすう}→点数：04543_tensuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ばらばら⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The test scores were all over the place — some people scored high, others low.

notes:
ばらばら is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) describing things that are scattered, separated, or inconsistent.

SENSE 1 — PHYSICALLY SCATTERED:
- ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to fall apart, to scatter
- ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall scattered
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら: documents are scattered

SENSE 2 — INCONSISTENT/VARIED:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら: opinions differ widely
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら: times are all different
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ばらばら: grades are uneven

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become scattered/separated
- ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live separately (family members in different places)
- ばらばら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take apart, to separate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧: messed up, chaotic (stronger)
- ⟦ぐちゃぐちゃ→ぐちゃぐちゃ：05170_guchagucha⟧: jumbled, mixed up (messy)
- ⟦てんでんばらばら→てんでんばらばら：noentry⟧: each going their own way
